<function name="SetToneMappingScaleLinear" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<description>Sets the tone mapping scale for upcoming rendering operations.</description>
	<args>
		<arg name="scales" type="Vector">The tonemapping scales.
* X - Output scale.
* Y - Lightmap scale.
* Z - Reflection map scale.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>This disables HDR bloom effect for the rendering inside the block.</description>
	<code>
local tune_nohdr = Vector( 0.80, 0, 0 )

local oldtune = render.GetToneMappingScaleLinear()
render.SetToneMappingScaleLinear( tune_nohdr ) -- Turns off hdr
   
-- render your stuff

render.SetToneMappingScaleLinear( oldtune ) -- Resets hdr
	</code>
</example>
